A headerless table whose rows have different cell counts is padded, not turned into a list

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td>A</td><td>B</td></tr><tr><td>C</td></tr></table>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
